messages.author: MarcusVickEBC
messages.text:
The “dropped glove save into the net” occurs because of the net collision logic in the game. 

There isn’t anything in the game that makes the goalie drop a glove save. 

Instead, the reaching glove save moves the puck into the net’s collision region, and that logic removes possession. So the puck drops.
